```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
METHOD_SIM_DIR <- file.path(RESULT_DIR, "11_method_similarity")
METHOD_SIM_FIG <- file.path(METHOD_SIM_DIR, "plots")
METHOD_SIM_TAB <- file.path(METHOD_SIM_DIR, "tables")

OUTPUT_FIG_DIR <- METHOD_SIM_FIG
OUTPUT_TAB_DIR <- METHOD_SIM_TAB


prepare_module_outputs(
  OUTPUT_FIG_DIR,
  OUTPUT_TAB_DIR,
  c(
    "01_design_qc",
    "02_rna_class_composition",
    "03_detection_sensitivity",
    "04_length_distribution",
    "05_pairwise_similarity",
    "06_reproducibility",
    "07_class_focused_evidence"
  )
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
activate_serum_context(environment(), analysis_scope = "method_comparison")
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- length(pandora_group_n) >= 2L && all(pandora_group_n >= 2L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")

```

```{r config, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
available_groups <- as.character(group_levels)
method_palette <- group_palette[available_groups]
names(method_palette) <- available_groups
method_factor <- function(x) factor(as.character(x), levels = available_groups)

method_sample_design <- sample_info %>%
  transmute(
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Method = as.character(Method),
    Condition = as.character(Condition),
    SampleType = as.character(SampleType),
    Species = as.character(Species),
    Matrix = as.character(Matrix),
    BiologicalSample = as.character(BiologicalSample),
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Replicate = as.character(Replicate),
    Batch = as.character(Batch),
    PairID = as.character(PairID)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups), Sample)

method_design <- method_sample_design %>%
  group_by(Group, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
    BiologicalSampleN = n_distinct(BiologicalSample),
    ReplicateN = n_distinct(Replicate),
    Samples = paste(Sample, collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups))

write_csv_safe(method_sample_design, "method_sample_design.csv")
write_csv_safe(method_design, "method_design.csv")
```

```{r helpers, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (all(!is.finite(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x[is.finite(x)])
}

safe_sum <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (all(!is.finite(x))) 0 else sum(x[is.finite(x)])
}

safe_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) NA_real_ else stats::sd(x)
}

group_percent <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  total <- sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(total) || total <= 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  100 * x / total
}

expected_detected_features <- function(feature_reads, clean_reads, target_depth) {
  feature_reads <- as.numeric(feature_reads)
  clean_reads <- as.numeric(clean_reads)
  if (!is.finite(clean_reads) || clean_reads <= 0 || !is.finite(target_depth) || target_depth <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  feature_reads <- feature_reads[is.finite(feature_reads) & feature_reads > 0]
  if (length(feature_reads) == 0) return(0)
  sum(1 - exp(-target_depth * feature_reads / clean_reads))
}

theme_method <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f3f4f6", color = "#d1d5db")
    )
}

complete_numeric_columns <- function(df, cols, value = 0) {
  for (col in cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- value
  }
  df
}

matrix_to_long <- function(mat, value_name) {
  as.data.frame(as.table(mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    setNames(c("Row", "Column", value_name)) %>%
    mutate(Row = factor(Row, levels = rev(available_groups)), Column = factor(Column, levels = available_groups))
}

plot_heatmap <- function(df, x_col, y_col, value_col, title_text, fill_label, limits = NULL, digits = 2) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[y_col]], fill = .data[[value_col]])) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(.data[[value_col]]), "NA", round(.data[[value_col]], digits))), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#d73027", "#fee08b", "#1a9850"), limits = limits, na.value = "#e5e7eb") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = fill_label, title = title_text) +
    theme_method(10) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
```

# 1. Design, Read Depth, and Mapping QC

```{r design_qc, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
sample_qc_metrics <- sample_qc_table %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Method = as.character(Group),
    Replicate = as.character(Replicate),
    CleanReads = as.numeric(CleanReads),
    MatchGenome = as.numeric(MatchGenome),
    GenomeRate = as.numeric(GenomeRate),
    DominantCategory = as.character(DominantCategory),
    DominantPercent = as.numeric(DominantPercent)
  )

composition_categories <- c(
  "rsRNA", "snRNA", "miRNA", "tsRNA", "mt_tsRNA", "piRNA",
  "lncRNA", "snoRNA", "ysRNA", "unanno_MG", "unanno_UMG", "other"
)

sample_composition <- sample_comp_view %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Method = as.character(Group),
    MainCategory = as.character(MainCategory),
    Reads = as.numeric(Reads),
    Percent = as.numeric(Percent)
  ) %>%
  filter(MainCategory %in% composition_categories) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Method, MainCategory) %>%
  summarise(Reads = safe_sum(Reads), Percent = safe_sum(Percent), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    tidyr::nesting(Sample, Group, Method),
    MainCategory = composition_categories,
    fill = list(Reads = 0, Percent = 0)
  )

sample_qc_metrics <- sample_qc_metrics %>%
  left_join(
    sample_composition %>%
      group_by(Sample, Group, Method) %>%
      summarise(
        AnnotatedSncPercent = sum(Percent[!MainCategory %in% c("unanno_MG", "unanno_UMG", "other")], na.rm = TRUE),
        UnannotatedPercent = sum(Percent[MainCategory %in% c("unanno_MG", "unanno_UMG")], na.rm = TRUE),
        OtherPercent = sum(Percent[MainCategory == "other"], na.rm = TRUE),
        RsRNAPercent = sum(Percent[MainCategory == "rsRNA"], na.rm = TRUE),
        NonRsrnaAnnotatedPercent = sum(Percent[!MainCategory %in% c("unanno_MG", "unanno_UMG", "other", "rsRNA")], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("Sample", "Group", "Method")
  )

method_qc_summary <- sample_qc_metrics %>%
  group_by(Group, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
    CleanReadsMean = safe_mean(CleanReads),
    CleanReadsSD = safe_sd(CleanReads),
    GenomeRateMean = safe_mean(GenomeRate),
    GenomeRateSD = safe_sd(GenomeRate),
    AnnotatedSncPercentMean = safe_mean(AnnotatedSncPercent),
    UnannotatedPercentMean = safe_mean(UnannotatedPercent),
    OtherPercentMean = safe_mean(OtherPercent),
    RsRNAPercentMean = safe_mean(RsRNAPercent),
    NonRsrnaAnnotatedPercentMean = safe_mean(NonRsrnaAnnotatedPercent),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups))

write_csv_safe(sample_qc_metrics, "sample_qc_metrics.csv")
write_csv_safe(method_qc_summary, "method_qc_summary.csv")

clean_reads_plot <- sample_qc_metrics %>%
  mutate(Method = method_factor(Method)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = CleanReads, fill = Method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Sample), angle = 90, hjust = -0.08, size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Clean reads", title = "Clean Reads per Sample") +
  theme_method(10)

save_plot_nested(clean_reads_plot, "01_design_qc", "clean_reads_by_sample.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 5.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)

mapping_plot <- sample_qc_metrics %>%
  mutate(Method = method_factor(Method)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = GenomeRate, fill = Method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", GenomeRate)), vjust = -0.25, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(sample_qc_metrics$GenomeRate, na.rm = TRUE) - 1, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Genome mapping rate (%)", title = "Genome Mapping Rate per Sample") +
  theme_method(10)

save_plot_nested(mapping_plot, "01_design_qc", "genome_mapping_rate_by_sample.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 5.2, view = REPORT_VIEW)

annotation_partition <- sample_qc_metrics %>%
  select(Sample, Method, AnnotatedSncPercent, UnannotatedPercent, OtherPercent) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AnnotatedSncPercent, UnannotatedPercent, OtherPercent),
    names_to = "Partition",
    values_to = "Percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = method_factor(Method),
    Partition = recode(
      Partition,
      AnnotatedSncPercent = "Annotated sncRNA",
      UnannotatedPercent = "Unannotated",
      OtherPercent = "Other"
    ),
    Partition = factor(Partition, levels = c("Annotated sncRNA", "Unannotated", "Other"))
  )

partition_plot <- ggplot(annotation_partition, aes(x = Method, y = Percent, fill = Partition)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Annotated sncRNA" = "#4c78a8", "Unannotated" = "#f58518", "Other" = "#bdbdbd")) +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Read percentage", fill = NULL, title = "Annotated versus Unannotated Read Fraction") +
  theme_method(10)

save_plot_nested(partition_plot, "01_design_qc", "annotated_unannotated_fraction.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 5.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)

knitr::kable(method_qc_summary %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2))), caption = "Objective QC summary by method.")
```

# 2. RNA-Class Composition

```{r rna_class_composition, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
method_composition_summary <- sample_composition %>%
  group_by(Group, Method, MainCategory) %>%
  summarise(
    PercentMean = safe_mean(Percent),
    PercentSD = safe_sd(Percent),
    ReadsMean = safe_mean(Reads),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups), desc(PercentMean))

composition_palette <- category_palette[composition_categories]
composition_palette[is.na(composition_palette)] <- "#9ca3af"

write_csv_safe(method_composition_summary, "method_composition_summary.csv")

sample_composition_plot <- sample_composition %>%
  left_join(method_sample_design %>% select(Sample, Replicate), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    Method = method_factor(Method),
    MainCategory = factor(MainCategory, levels = composition_categories),
    SampleLabel = factor(Sample, levels = method_sample_design$Sample)
  )

composition_by_sample_plot <- ggplot(sample_composition_plot, aes(x = SampleLabel, y = Percent, fill = MainCategory)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.82, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = composition_palette, drop = FALSE, na.value = "#bdbdbd") +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Read percentage", fill = "RNA class", title = "RNA-Class Composition by Sample") +
  theme_method(9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

save_plot_nested(composition_by_sample_plot, "02_rna_class_composition", "rna_class_composition_by_sample.pdf", width = 11, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)

composition_by_method_plot <- method_composition_summary %>%
  mutate(Method = method_factor(Method), MainCategory = factor(MainCategory, levels = composition_categories)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = PercentMean, fill = MainCategory)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = composition_palette, drop = FALSE, na.value = "#bdbdbd") +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Mean read percentage", fill = "RNA class", title = "Mean RNA-Class Composition by Method") +

save_plot_nested(composition_by_method_plot, "02_rna_class_composition", "rna_class_composition_by_method.pdf", width = 10.5, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)

composition_heatmap <- method_composition_summary %>%
  mutate(Method = method_factor(Method), MainCategory = factor(MainCategory, levels = rev(composition_categories))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = MainCategory, fill = PercentMean)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", PercentMean)), size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#f7fbff", "#6baed6", "#08306b"), na.value = "#e5e7eb") +
  labs(x = "Method", y = NULL, fill = "%", title = "RNA-Class Percentage Heatmap") +
  theme_method(10)

save_plot_nested(composition_heatmap, "02_rna_class_composition", "rna_class_percent_heatmap.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 6.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)

key_class_plot <- method_composition_summary %>%
  filter(MainCategory %in% c("rsRNA", "snRNA", "miRNA", "tsRNA", "lncRNA", "unanno_MG", "unanno_UMG")) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_factor(Method), MainCategory = factor(MainCategory, levels = c("rsRNA", "snRNA", "miRNA", "tsRNA", "lncRNA", "unanno_MG", "unanno_UMG"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = PercentMean, fill = Method)) +
```

# 3. Detection Sensitivity

```{r detection_sensitivity, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
annotation_sample_abundance <- sports_annotation_counts(summary_all, clean_reads_tbl) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Method = as.character(Group),
    Feature = as.character(PrimaryAnnotation),
    FeatureCategory = as.character(FeatureCategory),
    Reads = as.numeric(Reads),
    RPM = as.numeric(RPM)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Feature), nzchar(Feature), Feature != "NO_Annotation") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Method, Feature, FeatureCategory) %>%
  summarise(Reads = safe_sum(Reads), RPM = safe_sum(RPM), .groups = "drop")

sequence_sample_abundance <- output_all %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Method = as.character(Group),
    Feature = as.character(Sequence),
    Reads = as.numeric(Reads),
    RPM = as.numeric(RPM)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Feature), nzchar(Feature)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Method, Feature) %>%
  summarise(Reads = safe_sum(Reads), RPM = safe_sum(RPM), .groups = "drop")

annotation_group_abundance <- annotation_sample_abundance %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm(c("Feature", "FeatureCategory"), sample_info_df = sample_info) %>%
  transmute(Group, Method = as.character(Group), Feature, FeatureCategory, MeanRPM = RPM, TotalReads = Reads)

sequence_group_abundance <- sequence_sample_abundance %>%
  group_by(Group, Method, Feature) %>%
  summarise(MeanRPM = safe_mean(RPM), TotalReads = safe_sum(Reads), .groups = "drop")

detection_counts_by_sample <- full_join(
  annotation_sample_abundance %>%
    filter(RPM > 0) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, Method) %>%
    summarise(DetectedAnnotations = n_distinct(Feature), .groups = "drop"),
  sequence_sample_abundance %>%
    filter(RPM > 0) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, Method) %>%
    summarise(DetectedSequences = n_distinct(Feature), .groups = "drop"),
  by = c("Sample", "Group", "Method")
) %>%
  mutate(
    DetectedAnnotations = replace_na(DetectedAnnotations, 0),
    DetectedSequences = replace_na(DetectedSequences, 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(sample_qc_metrics %>% select(Sample, CleanReads), by = "Sample") %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups), Sample)

detection_counts_by_method <- detection_counts_by_sample %>%
  group_by(Group, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    DetectedAnnotationsMean = safe_mean(DetectedAnnotations),
    DetectedAnnotationsSD = safe_sd(DetectedAnnotations),
    DetectedSequencesMean = safe_mean(DetectedSequences),
    DetectedSequencesSD = safe_sd(DetectedSequences),
    SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups))

write_csv_safe(detection_counts_by_sample, "detection_counts_by_sample.csv")
write_csv_safe(detection_counts_by_method, "detection_counts_by_method.csv")

observed_detection_plot <- detection_counts_by_sample %>%
  select(Sample, Method, DetectedAnnotations, DetectedSequences) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(DetectedAnnotations, DetectedSequences), names_to = "DetectionLevel", values_to = "DetectedN") %>%
  mutate(
    Method = method_factor(Method),
    DetectionLevel = recode(DetectionLevel, DetectedAnnotations = "Annotated features", DetectedSequences = "Unique sequences")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = DetectedN, fill = Method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~DetectionLevel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Detected count", title = "Observed Detection Counts per Sample") +
  theme_method(10)

save_plot_nested(observed_detection_plot, "03_detection_sensitivity", "observed_detection_counts.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 7, view = REPORT_VIEW)

depth_targets <- c(500000, 1000000, 5000000, 10000000, 20000000)

annotation_depth_sample <- annotation_sample_abundance %>%
  left_join(sample_qc_metrics %>% select(Sample, CleanReads), by = "Sample") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Method, CleanReads) %>%
  summarise(ReadsVector = list(Reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::crossing(TargetDepth = depth_targets) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    DetectionLevel = "Annotated features",
    ExpectedDetected = expected_detected_features(unlist(ReadsVector), CleanReads, TargetDepth),
    DepthAvailable = is.finite(CleanReads) & CleanReads >= TargetDepth
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Sample, Group, Method, DetectionLevel, CleanReads, TargetDepth, ExpectedDetected, DepthAvailable)

sequence_depth_sample <- sequence_sample_abundance %>%
  left_join(sample_qc_metrics %>% select(Sample, CleanReads), by = "Sample") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Method, CleanReads) %>%
  summarise(ReadsVector = list(Reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::crossing(TargetDepth = depth_targets) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    DetectionLevel = "Unique sequences",
    ExpectedDetected = expected_detected_features(unlist(ReadsVector), CleanReads, TargetDepth),
    DepthAvailable = is.finite(CleanReads) & CleanReads >= TargetDepth
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Sample, Group, Method, DetectionLevel, CleanReads, TargetDepth, ExpectedDetected, DepthAvailable)

depth_normalized_sensitivity_by_sample <- bind_rows(annotation_depth_sample, sequence_depth_sample)

depth_normalized_sensitivity_summary <- depth_normalized_sensitivity_by_sample %>%
  group_by(Group, Method, DetectionLevel, TargetDepth) %>%
  summarise(
    ExpectedDetectedMean = safe_mean(ExpectedDetected),
    ExpectedDetectedSD = safe_sd(ExpectedDetected),
    DepthAvailableN = sum(DepthAvailable, na.rm = TRUE),
    SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups), DetectionLevel, TargetDepth)

write_csv_safe(depth_normalized_sensitivity_by_sample, "depth_normalized_sensitivity_by_sample.csv")
write_csv_safe(depth_normalized_sensitivity_summary, "depth_normalized_sensitivity_summary.csv")

depth_plot <- depth_normalized_sensitivity_summary %>%
  mutate(Method = method_factor(Method)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = TargetDepth, y = ExpectedDetectedMean, color = Method, group = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~DetectionLevel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = depth_targets, labels = paste0(depth_targets / 1e6, "M")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Normalized read depth", y = "Expected detected count", color = "Method", title = "Depth-Normalized Detection Curves") +
  theme_method(10)

save_plot_nested(depth_plot, "03_detection_sensitivity", "depth_normalized_detection_curves.pdf", width = 10, height = 7, view = REPORT_VIEW)

annotation_category_counts <- annotation_group_abundance %>%
  filter(MeanRPM > 0) %>%
  group_by(Group, Method, FeatureCategory) %>%
  summarise(DetectedAnnotations = n_distinct(Feature), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups), desc(DetectedAnnotations))

write_csv_safe(annotation_category_counts, "annotation_category_counts.csv")

category_count_plot <- annotation_category_counts %>%
  group_by(FeatureCategory) %>%
  filter(sum(DetectedAnnotations, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Method = method_factor(Method), FeatureCategory = reorder(FeatureCategory, DetectedAnnotations, sum)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = FeatureCategory, fill = DetectedAnnotations)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(label = DetectedAnnotations), size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#f7fbff", "#6baed6", "#08306b"), na.value = "#e5e7eb") +
  labs(x = "Method", y = NULL, fill = "Feature count", title = "Detected Annotation Counts by RNA Class") +
  theme_method(10)

save_plot_nested(category_count_plot, "03_detection_sensitivity", "annotation_category_count_heatmap.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 6.8, view = REPORT_VIEW)
```

# 4. Length Distribution

```{r length_distribution, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
clean_length_sample <- length_all_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Method = as.character(Group),
    Length = as.integer(Length),
    Reads = as.numeric(Reads)
  ) %>%
  filter(Class == "Clean_Reads", is.finite(Length), is.finite(Reads), Reads > 0) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Method, Length) %>%
  summarise(Reads = safe_sum(Reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Method) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

length_profile_summary <- clean_length_sample %>%
  group_by(Group, Method, Length) %>%
  summarise(PercentMean = safe_mean(Percent), PercentSD = safe_sd(Percent), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(match(Group, available_groups), Length)
```

# 5. Pairwise Similarity and Top-Feature Overlap

```{r pairwise_similarity, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
build_group_feature_matrix <- function(group_abundance) {
  group_abundance %>%
    select(Group, Feature, MeanRPM) %>%
    mutate(Group = as.character(Group), Feature = as.character(Feature), MeanRPM = as.numeric(MeanRPM)) %>%
    group_by(Group, Feature) %>%
    summarise(MeanRPM = safe_sum(MeanRPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = MeanRPM, values_fill = 0) %>%
    select(Feature, all_of(available_groups))
}

pairwise_cor_long <- function(feature_matrix, method = "spearman") {
  mat <- as.matrix(feature_matrix[, available_groups, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  corr <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(available_groups), ncol = length(available_groups), dimnames = list(available_groups, available_groups))
  for (g1 in available_groups) {
    for (g2 in available_groups) {
      corr[g1, g2] <- if (g1 == g2) 1 else safe_cor(log2(mat[, g1] + 1), log2(mat[, g2] + 1), method = method)
    }
  }
  matrix_to_long(corr, paste0(method, "_correlation"))
}

top_jaccard_long <- function(group_abundance, top_n = 50) {
  top_sets <- lapply(available_groups, function(group_id) {
    group_abundance %>%
      filter(Group == group_id, MeanRPM > 0) %>%
      arrange(desc(MeanRPM)) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      pull(Feature) %>%
      unique()
  })
  names(top_sets) <- available_groups
  mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(available_groups), ncol = length(available_groups), dimnames = list(available_groups, available_groups))
  for (g1 in available_groups) {
    for (g2 in available_groups) {
      union_n <- length(union(top_sets[[g1]], top_sets[[g2]]))
      mat[g1, g2] <- if (union_n == 0) NA_real_ else length(intersect(top_sets[[g1]], top_sets[[g2]])) / union_n
    }
  }
  matrix_to_long(mat, "TopJaccard") %>% mutate(TopN = top_n)
}

annotation_feature_matrix <- build_group_feature_matrix(annotation_group_abundance)
sequence_feature_matrix <- build_group_feature_matrix(sequence_group_abundance)

annotation_spearman <- pairwise_cor_long(annotation_feature_matrix, method = "spearman") %>%
  mutate(FeatureLevel = "Annotated features")
sequence_spearman <- pairwise_cor_long(sequence_feature_matrix, method = "spearman") %>%
  mutate(FeatureLevel = "Unique sequences")

pairwise_similarity_metrics <- bind_rows(annotation_spearman, sequence_spearman)

)

sequence_similarity_plot <- plot_heatmap(

)

save_plot_nested(sequence_similarity_plot, "05_pairwise_similarity", "sequence_spearman_heatmap.pdf", width = 7.2, height = 6.2, view = REPORT_VIEW)

composition_distance_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(available_groups), ncol = length(available_groups), dimnames = list(available_groups, available_groups))
for (g1 in available_groups) {
  for (g2 in available_groups) {
    v1 <- composition_wide %>% filter(Method == g1) %>% select(all_of(composition_categories)) %>% as.numeric()
    v2 <- composition_wide %>% filter(Method == g2) %>% select(all_of(composition_categories)) %>% as.numeric()
    composition_distance_mat[g1, g2] <- 0.5 * sum(abs(v1 - v2), na.rm = TRUE) / 100
  }
}
```

# 6. 技术重复：检出重叠与共同特征一致性

```{r reproducibility, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
ctx_all <- load_serum_context(REPORT_VIEW, "all")
ctx_method <- load_serum_context(REPORT_VIEW, "method_comparison")
replicate_annotation_exclusion_status <- ctx_all$output_all %>%
  filter(Sequence %in% spikein_edit1_sequences(SPIKEIN_SEQ)) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    CandidateReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    AnnotatedCandidateReads = sum(Reads[!is.na(Annotation) & !Annotation %in% c("", "NO_Annotation")], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(ctx_all$sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample)), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    CandidateReads = replace_na(CandidateReads, 0),
    AnnotatedCandidateReads = replace_na(AnnotatedCandidateReads, 0),
    AnnotationCountSource = "SPORTS allocated SubClass counts",
    Status = if_else(AnnotatedCandidateReads > 0, "annotated_spikein_candidate_requires_review", "no_spikein_candidate_in_annotation_counts")
  )
write_csv_safe(replicate_annotation_exclusion_status, "replicate_annotation_exclusion_status.csv")
replicate_pair_specs <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(c("1", "2"), function(method_id) {
    samples <- method_sample_design %>% filter(Method == method_id) %>% pull(Sample)
    if (length(samples) < 2) return(tibble())
    map_dfr(utils::combn(samples, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(x) {
      tibble(PairType = "within_method", Method = method_id, SampleA = x[[1]], SampleB = x[[2]])
    })
  }),
  tibble(
    PairType = "spikein_process_pair", Method = "1",
    SampleA = SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE, SampleB = SPIKEIN_SAMPLE
  )
) %>%
  mutate(PairLabel = paste(SampleA, SampleB, sep = " vs "))

build_replicate_abundance <- function(ctx, sample_a, sample_b, feature_level) {
  pair_meta <- ctx$sample_info %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) %in% c(sample_a, sample_b)) %>%
    transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
    left_join(ctx$clean_reads_tbl %>% mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)), by = "Sample")
  if (nrow(pair_meta) != 2) stop("重复性配对样本不存在: ", sample_a, ", ", sample_b)

  candidates <- spikein_edit1_sequences(SPIKEIN_SEQ)
  candidate_reads <- ctx$output_all %>%
    filter(Sequence %in% candidates) %>%
    mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    summarise(CandidateReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  pair_meta <- pair_meta %>%
    left_join(candidate_reads, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(CandidateReads = coalesce(CandidateReads, 0), EndogenousCleanReads = CleanReads - CandidateReads)

  if (feature_level == "annotation") {
    if (any(replicate_annotation_exclusion_status$AnnotatedCandidateReads[
      replicate_annotation_exclusion_status$Sample %in% c(sample_a, sample_b)] > 0)) {
      stop("外参候选存在有效注释；无法从 SPORTS 分配计数精确扣除，见 replicate_annotation_exclusion_status.csv。")
    }
    df <- sports_annotation_counts(ctx$summary_all, ctx$clean_reads_tbl) %>%
      filter(Sample %in% c(sample_a, sample_b)) %>%
      transmute(Sample, Feature = PrimaryAnnotation, Reads)
  } else {
    df <- ctx$output_all %>%
      filter(as.character(Sample) %in% c(sample_a, sample_b), !Sequence %in% candidates,
             !is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "") %>%
      transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = as.character(Sequence), Reads)
  }
  counts <- df %>%
    group_by(Sample, Feature) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0)
  for (sample_name in c(sample_a, sample_b)) if (!sample_name %in% names(counts)) counts[[sample_name]] <- 0
  denom_a <- pair_meta$EndogenousCleanReads[match(sample_a, pair_meta$Sample)]
  denom_b <- pair_meta$EndogenousCleanReads[match(sample_b, pair_meta$Sample)]
  counts %>%
    transmute(
      Feature,
      SampleACPM = 1e6 * .data[[sample_a]] / denom_a,
      SampleBCPM = 1e6 * .data[[sample_b]] / denom_b
    )
}

technical_replicate_agreement_metrics <- pmap_dfr(replicate_pair_specs, function(PairType, Method, SampleA, SampleB, PairLabel) {
  ctx <- if (PairType == "spikein_process_pair") ctx_all else ctx_method
  bind_rows(map(c("annotation", "unique_sequence"), function(level) {
    abundance <- build_replicate_abundance(ctx, SampleA, SampleB, level)
    compute_pair_agreement_metrics(
      abundance, "SampleACPM", "SampleBCPM", level,
      SampleA, SampleB, thresholds = c(0.5, 1, 5)
    )
  })) %>%
    mutate(PairType = PairType, Method = Method, PairLabel = PairLabel, .before = 1)
})
write_csv_safe(technical_replicate_agreement_metrics, "technical_replicate_agreement_metrics.csv")

technical_replicate_summary <- technical_replicate_agreement_metrics %>%
  filter(PairType == "within_method") %>%
  group_by(Method, FeatureLevel, CPMThreshold) %>%
  summarise(
    PairN = n(),
    JaccardMedian = median(Jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    JaccardMin = min(Jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    JaccardMax = max(Jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    SharedSpearmanMedian = median(SharedSpearman, na.rm = TRUE),
    SharedSpearmanMin = min(SharedSpearman, na.rm = TRUE),
    SharedSpearmanMax = max(SharedSpearman, na.rm = TRUE),
    MedianAbsLog2FCMedian = median(SharedMedianAbsLog2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
    WithinTwoFoldPctMedian = median(SharedWithinTwoFoldPct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
write_csv_safe(technical_replicate_summary, "technical_replicate_agreement_summary.csv")

agreement_plot_df <- technical_replicate_agreement_metrics %>%
  filter(CPMThreshold == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = case_when(
      PairType == "spikein_process_pair" ~ "Donor 3 spike-in pair (n=1)",
      TRUE ~ paste0("Method ", Method, " technical replicates (3 pairs)")
    ),
    FeatureLevel = recode(FeatureLevel, annotation = "annotation", unique_sequence = "unique sequence")
  )

p_overlap_repro <- ggplot(agreement_plot_df, aes(Comparison, Jaccard, color = FeatureLevel, shape = PairType)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(annotation = serum_blue, "unique sequence" = serum_orange)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(within_method = 16, spikein_process_pair = 17)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Detection overlap at CPM >= 1", x = NULL, y = "Jaccard", color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_method(10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 22, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

p_rank_repro <- ggplot(agreement_plot_df, aes(Comparison, SharedSpearman, color = FeatureLevel, shape = PairType)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(annotation = serum_blue, "unique sequence" = serum_orange)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(within_method = 16, spikein_process_pair = 17)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Abundance ranks of shared features at CPM >= 1", x = NULL, y = "Spearman rho", color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_method(10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 22, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

if (!pkg_has("patchwork")) stop("模块 11 需要 patchwork 组合重复性图。")
save_plot_nested(
  ((p_overlap_repro | p_rank_repro) + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")) &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical"),
  "06_reproducibility", "technical_replicate_agreement.pdf",
  width = 13, height = 5.8, view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```
